SPELL_ABILITY.LOCALISED_TEXT: Gain control of target creature until end of turn. Untap that creature. It gains haste until end of turn. Scry 1.
Acquérez le contrôle de la créature ciblée jusqu’à la fin du tour. Dégagez cette créature. Elle acquiert la célérité jusqu’à la fin du tour. Regard 1.
Gana el control de la criatura objetivo hasta el final del turno. Endereza esa criatura. Gana la habilidad de prisa hasta el final del turno. Adivina 1.
Übernimm bis zum Ende des Zuges die Kontrolle über eine Kreatur deiner Wahl. Enttappe diese Kreatur. Sie erhält Eile bis zum Ende des Zuges. Hellsicht 1.
Prendi il controllo di una creatura bersaglio fino alla fine del turno. STAPpa quella creatura. Ha rapidità fino alla fine del turno. Profetizza 1.
クリーチャー１体を対象とし、ターン終了時までそれのコントロールを得る。そのクリーチャーをアンタップする。それはターン終了時まで速攻を得る。占術１を行う。
생물 한 개를 목표로 정한다. 당신은 턴종료까지 그 생물의 조종권을 얻는다. 그 생물은 언탭되며 턴종료까지 신속을 얻는다. 점술 1.
Получите контроль над целевым существом до конца хода. Разверните то существо. Оно получает Ускорение до конца хода. Предскажите 1.
Ganhe o controle da criatura alvo até o final do turno. Desvire aquela criatura. Ela ganha ímpeto até o final do turno. Vidência 1.
获得目标生物的操控权直到回合结束。重置该生物。它获得敏捷异能直到回合结束。占卜1。
獲得目標生物的操控權直到回合結束。重置該生物。它獲得敏捷異能直到回合結束。占卜1。
SPELL_ABILITY.TARGET_DEFINITION: local filter = ClearFilter() filter:Add( FE_TYPE, OP_IS, CARD_TYPE_CREATURE )
SPELL_ABILITY.RESOLUTION_TIME_ACTION: local card = EffectDC():Get_Targets(0):Get_CardPtr(0) if card ~= nil then card:MidResolutionSetController(EffectController()) end
SPELL_ABILITY.CONTINUOUS_ACTION: local card = EffectDC():Get_Targets(0):Get_CardPtr(0) if card ~= nil then card:SetController(EffectController()) end
SPELL_ABILITY.RESOLUTION_TIME_ACTION: local target = EffectDC():Get_Targets(0):Get_CardPtr(0) if target ~= nil then target:Untap() end
SPELL_ABILITY.CONTINUOUS_ACTION: local target = EffectDC():Get_Targets(0):Get_CardPtr(0) if target ~= nil then local characteristics = target:GetCurrentCharacteristics() characteristics:Bool_Set(CHARACTERISTIC_HASTE, 1) end
SPELL_ABILITY.RESOLUTION_TIME_ACTION:
local rep_count = MTG():GetActionRepCount() if rep_count == 0 then ------------------------------- -- 1) ASK FIRST SCRY QUESTION ------------------------------- local scry_value = 1 -- Fill InputDC with top N cards of library local cards_found = 0 local scryDC = EffectDC():Make_Chest(1) local scryInputDC = scryDC:Make_Chest(0) for i=0,scry_value-1 do local card = EffectController():Library_GetNth(i)
if card ~= nil then scryInputDC:Set_CardPtr(cards_found, card)
cards_found = cards_found + 1 end end
if cards_found == 0 then -- No cards in library, end return false end
-- If scrying a single card, multiple choice it if scry_value == 1 or cards_found == 1 then local effectController = EffectController() if effectController ~= nil then effectController:BeginNewMultipleChoice() effectController:AddMultipleChoiceAnswer( "CARD_QUERY_SCRY_ONE_TOP" ) effectController:AddMultipleChoiceAnswer( "CARD_QUERY_SCRY_ONE_BOTTOM", TRANSITION_BOTTOM_OF_LIBRARY ) effectController:AskMultipleChoiceQuestion( "CARD_QUERY_SCRY_ONE_QUESTION", EffectController():Library_GetTop() ) end return true end local scryTopDC = scryDC:Make_Chest(1)
-- If scrying more than 1 card, we need a browser if cards_found > 1 then -- Ask query EffectController():SetItemCount( cards_found )
for i=0,cards_found-1 do EffectController():SetItemPrompt( i, "CARD_QUERY_SCRY_TOP" ) end
EffectController():ChooseItemsFromDC( scryInputDC, scryTopDC, QUERY_FLAG_UP_TO + QUERY_FLAG_ORDERED_SELECTION ) end return true elseif rep_count == 1 then ------------------------------- -- 2) MOVE THE CARDS ------------------------------- local scryDC = EffectDC():Get_Chest(1) -- Get old chests, and determine actual scry value local scryInputDC = scryDC:Get_Chest(0) local scry_value = scryInputDC:Count() if scry_value == 1 then local answer = EffectController():GetMultipleChoiceResult() if answer == 0 then -- Scryed the single top card to top, nothing to do end if answer == 1 then -- Scry the top card to the bottom scryInputDC:Get_CardPtr(0):PutOnBottomOfLibrary() end else
local scryTopDC = scryDC:Get_Chest(1) local scry_top = scryTopDC:Count() if scry_value > 1 and scry_top < scry_value then -- Fill SecondInputDC with everything in InputDC not in TopDC ("what's left") for i=0,scry_value-1 do local card = scryInputDC:Get_CardPtr(i)
for j=0,scry_top-1 do if card == scryTopDC:Get_CardPtr(j) then -- chosen, ignore card = nil break end end
-- if not present in TopDC, move it to the bottom if card ~= nil then card:PutOnBottomOfLibrary() end end
-- Move chosen cards to top of library so first -- card chosen ends up on top of the library for i=0,scry_top-1 do local card = scryTopDC:Get_CardPtr(i)
if card ~= nil then card:PutOnTopOfLibrary() end end end end -- END return false end
